preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 150000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 300000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of monsters in each test case is between 2 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**12 for ai in ais)
preconditions.description: Health of each monster is between 1 and 10^12.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 10**12 for bi in bis)
preconditions.description: Damage dealt by each monster's explosion is between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(bullets, int) and bullets >= 0 for bullets in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of bullets needed.
